responsibility: Performs front-end tree/body cloning optimizations for C++ special member variants. It copies and remaps High GIMPLE function bodies for cloned constructors and destructors, preserves debug and parameter-origin information, builds deleting destructor bodies, decides when complete/base ctor-dtor variants can share bodies via aliases or thunks, and emits the resulting cloned or aliased functions into cgraph with appropriate COMDAT grouping.
